subject.title: feat: add codexbar cookie refresh CLI command

question: Should forced cookie re-import extend `codexbar cache clear --cookies` or remain a separate `cookie refresh` command, and must the CLI perform import itself or delegate it to the signed app?
rationale: The standalone CLI lacks the same signed-app browser and Keychain context, while the repository already exposes cache clearing; choosing the permanent command and entitlement boundary is product and compatibility policy rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Extend Existing Cache Command
options.body: Add an explicit re-import option to `cache clear --cookies`, delegate when the signed app is required, and reuse provider metadata for browser selection.

options.title: Keep Separate Refresh Command
options.body: Retain `cookie refresh`, but restrict it to providers it can truly restore and define accurate deferred behavior for the rest.

options.title: Pause CLI Surface
options.body: Pause the PR and first add an in-app re-import action where signing, prompts, and refresh state can be controlled.

recommendation.title: Extend Existing Cache Command
recommendation.body: Add an explicit re-import option to `cache clear --cookies`, delegate when the signed app is required, and reuse provider metadata for browser selection.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, this person is the strongest available owner for the permanent CLI and signed-app workflow decision.
